name: Timo Menzel
topics: 3D Scanning, Avatar Personalization & Real-Time Facial Animation
description:
I'm a PhD candidate and research assistant at TU Dortmund University working on graphics and geometry processing for digital human reconstruction. I design practical pipelines that transform smartphone captures into realistic full-body avatars and personalized facial animations for real-time and VR applications.
I'm interested in industry roles where I can apply my background in graphics engineering, 3D reconstruction, and performance-aware real-time graphics to build interactive and scalable 3D experiences.
